plan: Wave 6, from the actual state at v0.6.1. CORRECTION to the earlier open list: glTF (d078c6a) and X3D (3086159) both bake xform animation now, and the USDZ toggle has been live since 0.6.0, proven on 22.0.400/.492/.466. The items below are what is genuinely open.

environment.cloud: An AI coding agent in a git worktree with py -3.12 (usd-core 26.5), Node 24, Playwright, network; no Houdini, no hython, no prefs writes, no GitHub account actions.
environment.desk: Joe's Windows workstation: Houdini 22.0.x with hython, OneDrive prefs, gh CLI, a GUI session for Qt. Plain python 3.14 is broken; py -3.12 and hython work.
environment.joe: Joe Ibrahim, owner of taste, licensing, releases and the Synapse repo.

tasks.title: Finish animation honesty: scale-only X3D and non-xform attributes
tasks.detail: X3D has no ScaleInterpolator, so scale-only motion stays at the start pose; and neither writer detects animated attributes that are not transforms (points, shader inputs, visibility). Report the first and detect the second, so the report says exactly what is baked.

tasks.title: Record the verified limits in blueprint section 6
tasks.detail: Mark Quick Look as untested, note the three-probe animation detection limit, and record what the browser suites now prove.

tasks.title: Build the Qt report panel
tasks.detail: A panel rendering LossReport side by side per format, using a copy of Synapse's design system at commit 36148779. Needs a GUI session.

tasks.title: Wire the Synapse tool
tasks.detail: An optional tool in the Synapse repo calling webexport.api.export. The guardrail forbids editing that repo from here.

tasks.title: Upload the social preview image
tasks.detail: docs/assets/social-preview.png in Settings; no supported API.

tasks.title: Check the Preview button in the GUI
tasks.detail: Console flash, UI stall, and whether the server outlives Houdini.
